notes: GAAP village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance (p4-5, Total column); business-type lines from the Combined Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p15, Total column). Basic statement trimmed pages: p1 Statement of Net Position (report p4), p2 Statement of Activities, p3 governmental funds balance sheet, p4-5 governmental revenues/expenditures, p6 General Fund budget schedule, p7-11 General Fund departmental expenditure schedules, p12 Debt Service, p13 Street, p14 proprietary net position, p15 proprietary revenues/expenses. Balance sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column; it balances. Statement of Activities (p2) confirms sales tax 812,350, property taxes 613,167, other taxes 167,617 (= other taxes + MV tax + occupation etc. combined, no split needed since statement p4 prints each tax). Other financing: FEMA Grant, Grant - Other, Insurance proceeds are printed under Other Financing Sources on p5 and are combined into other_financing (computed). Transfers in (out) printed net per fund (General -207,054, Debt Service +8,600, Street +203,119, Keno -4,665): transfers_in = 8,600 + 203,119 = 211,719, transfers_out = 207,054 + 4,665 = 211,719, net zero; these tie (sending General and Keno equal receiving Debt Service and Street) and no transfer is hidden in spending lines (General Fund departmental totals tie to the p5 statement: G&A 210,198 + County commissions 3,058 = 213,256 on p6/p7). Identity: 2,411,764 + 2,001,434 - 2,836,907 + 211,719 - 211,719 + 0 + 196,681 = 1,772,972. ending_cash is Cash and Equivalents of the governmental funds balance sheet (p3) 952,849; restricted cash 658,068 (Debt Service 436,380, Keno 221,688) is separate and not included. Business-type: no printed single total, so reported_totals computed (receipts = operating revenues 868,779 + interest income 18,570 - loss on sale of assets 7,548 = 879,801; disbursements = operating expenses 1,051,632 + interest expense 2,659 = 1,054,291, which equals the Statement of Activities business-type expenses). Roll: 3,214,160 + 879,801 - 1,054,291 = 3,039,670. Water/Sewer transfers (-663/+663) net to zero. No Statement of Cash Flows in the trimmed PDF, so proprietary is null. Detail: General Fund expenditure detail recorded from the departmental object schedules (p7-11) which supersede the p6 function lines (p6 function lines not repeated; detail_totals are the printed department totals p7-11, which add to the p6 total 1,392,370); General Fund revenue and other financing from p6. Debt Service and Street schedules from p12-13. Keno fund has no separate schedule. Water/Sewer fund statements (p14-15) are basic statements, not repeated in detail. Capital outlay lines are kept under their function with detail_category equipment purchases and review since the type is not described. Fireworks revenue category guessed as licenses and permits. Read pages 1-15 of 15
